rules.statement: The absence of evidence relating to monetary or economic loss favors the plaintiff-respondent.
rules.supporting_quote: (1) Lack of material before Court regarding monetary or economic loss enures to the benefit of the plaintiff-respondent. (2) Questions of law arising for determination must be substantial in relation to the facts of the case at hand. (3) A prospective purchaser placed in possession of a premises was at best a licensee or a permissive occupier and cannot be equated to that of a tenant. Once the defendant-petitioner refused to accept Thaha as his landlord he forfeited his right to be called a tenant
